steps.note: S1.3.1.1.1 states the subtract, add, restore rows and that the net target change is (JV+RG)x whatever the scratch values a,c; it merges the paper's rows 2-3 (scratch update) and 4-5 (addition) into 'rows 2-5 add', which keeps the content.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the bit-network central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient 1.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two.
S1.3.1.1.3 states the inverse schedule X<-X-Y, the stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and that each invocation restores its own scratch wires.

The plan says every edge joins nested labels and that other edges 'split along A=B perp P and F=<t> perp t^perp' (S1.3.1.3, S1.3.1.3.5), but gives residuals only for the side edge 2->5 and center 3->4, not the per-edge residual table with its dimensions.

S1.3.1.3.4 states the side edge 2->5 is nested because <t_X> is contained in t_Y^perp for neighbors (with neighbor orthogonality in S1.3.1.3.1), with residual P tensor <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
The plan gives center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, telescoping to sink Wm-N minus source N, signed Wm-2N, and adding 2L for the absolute total Wm-2N+2L.
S1.3.3.3 only asserts that every nonzero binary residual has an orthonormal basis; the plan never argues that residuals are nonalternating or that alternating planes are absorbed.
S1.3.1.6 gives L/N=300c/v, equal to 100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), using I=3v^2, N=v^3 and v=161700, which match the paper (lines 655-676).
S1.3.3.1 states the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal residual basis of wt(v)[v.x], negated on a decreasing edge.
S1.3.3.2 states that odd weight gives i^{eps[v.x]}, writes its two-term expansion, and uses H diag(1,-1) H = X to get aI+bX_v or its inverse.

The plan counts s_c kernels (S1.3.3, S1.3.3.3) and says 'on any number of columns' only for the endpoint C^{tensor m}; it never states that on k columns each residual vector contributes one tensored factor.

S1.3.3.4-5 give frames I and C^{tensor m} for zero and full labels, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) on X_a->Y_a repaired by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and negation of the physical X outputs.
The plan states that both L/N are below 1/2 and derives the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, so s<Wm.
S1.3.4 states that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.

S1.4.1.1 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular invertible factors and Pi having exactly a ones, obtained by repeatedly eliminating around the rightmost nonzero entry of the topmost nonzero row; this compresses the clearing steps but keeps the pivot rule and the repetition.

S1.4.1 takes a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators of the factorization and works over Z/q^b with invertible lower-triangular factors; it does not mention the paper's extra condition on diagonal numerators, but nothing it says contradicts the paper.
S1.4.1.2 states the O(V) cost of a lower-triangular change by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each earlier coordinate still holding its original value.
S1.4.1.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, which takes (h,d) to (h+d,d) with one interchange, so a ones cost a interchanges.
S1.5.9 names Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2, nor the values nu=11 and C_1=20.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E with leaf bound 8e appears nowhere; the plan's only recurrence (S1.5.7) is the time recurrence.
S1.5.9 asserts the depth bound C_0 d^{C_1} without the unrolling B^{k+1} <= B^2 d^nu or the bound A(e) <= 8B^2 d^{nu+1}.

S1.5.9 states the p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits and Delta=o(p) from eps*C_1<1, but not the invariant that justifies them (a depth-l value lies in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l); I chose absent because that invariant is the derivation and the plan only asserts its consequence.
S1.5.10 states absolute row sum one, preservation of disk arrays, and a single final truncation with error below sqrt2 * 2^{-p}.

summary: P03 states 19 of 26 sub-steps. It covers the bank-exchange network (4/4), the rank saving (4/4) and the matrix shear (4/4) in full. The label budget has 3/5: the residual table (L1) and the nonalternating orthonormal-basis argument (L4) are missing. The phase interface has 3/4: the k-column tensoring (P3) is missing. The simultaneous layer has only 1/5: the guard-width derivation (constants, depth recurrence, unrolling, depth-to-size invariant) is replaced by a bare assertion in S1.5.9, and only the disk-preserving truncation (S5) is stated. No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
